scientific_integrity: Kolpakov 2026 chain classification, known face counts, and Kolpakov 2012 minimality are acknowledged; the work claims only the exact graph diameter, the nine extremal pairs, and the reflection-double distance histogram.
scientific_limitations: The graph metric is facet–ridge adjacency in the classified regular ideal right-angled 24-cell chains; it is not ambient hyperbolic distance. Unindexed equivalent historical graph calculations remain possible. The general proof relies on a finite exact transfer certificate and a stated min-plus identity; independent mathematical review is outstanding.
title: Facet-graph diameter and nine rigid antipodes in chains of ideal right-angled \(24\)-cells
